key_insight: Surrogate-guided reinforcement learning enriches perovskite recipe shortlists with candidates near high-performing measured devices, without establishing experimental performance.
engineering_relevance: The framework could help prioritize solar-cell recipes for fabrication across a large composition, device-layer, and processing design space.
method: Generate recipes using reinforcement learning guided by a frozen TabPFN surrogate.
Assess neighborhood support against 890 measured reference devices.
Compare three learned policies with six baselines using 3,000 surrogate evaluations per run.
evidence_signal: Five-fold evaluation on 1,846 devices raised top-ten mean PCE from 19.68% to 23.74%; top-100 neighborhood-supported hit rates reached 23–24% for PPO/RPPO versus 2.9% for Pure Random and 10% for the strongest baselines.
watch_item: Experimental performance, seed robustness, and matched-budget advantage remain unestablished; composition-family support drops from 65.4% at similarity 0.80 to 11.7% at 0.90.
paper_title: Enrichment-Oriented Virtual Screening of Perovskite Solar Cells through Reinforcement Learning
